behavioral_effects: test_openrouter_is_the_default_provider monkeypatches a placeholder OPENROUTER_API_KEY before building the model
limitations: Fix-forward: the CI test job was red from eb5a97e to efb00dd because this test only passed where a local key existed; the previous session's local run did not catch it
reason: test_openrouter_is_the_default_provider built a real OpenRouterModel and passed only where backend/.env supplied a key; on the CI runner pydantic-ai raised UserError for the missing key and the test job has been red since the fake-provider change landed. After this change the test sets a placeholder key before building the model, so it asserts provider selection rather than the presence of a credential.
security_impact: None. The placeholder string is set on the in-process settings object inside one test and is never sent anywhere.
summary: Make the default-provider test independent of a real OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment

validators_run.evidence_ref: tests/test_agents.py TestModelProvider 5 passed with backend/.env moved aside so no OPENROUTER_API_KEY was available - the condition that failed in CI
